title: STS2 Tracker v1.3.6 - Sleep & Power Mode Resilience, Auto-Updater Timeout Protection & Instant Recovery
changelog: Sleep & Power Mode Resilience: Integrated Windows SystemEvents.PowerModeChanged hook to prevent the background companion engine from shutting down when the PC enters sleep mode or suspends tabs
Removed Premature pagehide Beacon: Fixed Chromium Edge sleeping tabs and OS sleep dispatching false client_closed beacons
Smart Wake Reconnect: Added clock tick jump detection to gracefully pause telemetry sync and give network 4 seconds to reconnect after waking from sleep
Safe Auto-Updater Polling: Fixed version polling loop lock when already running target release, reduced timeout from 90s to 30s, and added Dismiss & Return to Dashboard overlay recovery controls
Fail-safe Process Restarter: Guaranteed companion restart even if file-swapping encounters a delay or file lock
notes: Fixes app freezing after sleep mode, adds Windows power event management, eliminates premature companion termination on sleeping tabs, and improves update polling resilience.
